text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I'm Mr. C.B. Looking forward to working 
with you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Rules and taboos mean nothing to me. I 
just run my own way.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'd be happy if you just let me run 
freely!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
